refunds.intro: You only pay for work you order and that we actually deliver. Here's a clear overview of when and how we invoice, and when we give money back.

monthly.p1: These services are invoiced monthly in advance. You can cancel by email at any time, effective at the end of the paid month — we won't issue any further invoices, and there's no cancellation fee.
monthly.p2: We don't refund a month that has already started, because the team has reserved that time for your project. But if in a given month we didn't deliver the agreed capacity for reasons on our side, we'll refund the difference or deduct it from the next invoice — whichever suits you.

payments.p1: You don't pay anything on this website, and we collect no payment details here. Payment only ever happens after a contract is signed, against an invoice, by bank transfer.
payments.p2: When each service is invoiced is described in the Prices and payments section of our Terms of Service.
